summary: The module spawn log printed MODULE_CONFIG values
details: The debug line formatted the whole process command, so MODULE_CONFIG values were written to the spawn log. The fix logs the module id only. origin/main commit 140bbeb9f98479b5bed1feb83824b98a56c79d57. Local stability/beta-gate has it as 3ebe0450fdb0580507d6c18af86071a5c842ae2d. The regression spawn_log_does_not_include_module_config passed on that commit. No release tag contains the fix. Reporter credit is blank pending consent. The report date was not separate from the fix commit.
